title: Clamp Score
description: Write a function named clamp_score that returns score if it lies between low and high, returns low if score is below it, and high if score is above it.

hidden_tests.kind: a score exactly on the low threshold
a score exactly on the high threshold

hints: Clamping requires setting boundary walls while leaving values within the interval unchanged.
Inspect the conditions in your function: are you comparing score against low and high separately?
Make sure your logic doesn't drop values that are exactly equal to low or high.
If score < low, return low. If score > high, return high. Otherwise, the score is valid as-is.
You can also use Python's built-in min and max functions: max(low, min(score, high)).
